given.note: A3-19: Alex asks Sam in person about Saturday, and Sam texts 'BOOK Alex M. haircut Sat 11am Riley' on Thu Oct 22, 10:00am. In Sam's turn the BOOK words are the chosen choice and this write is its effect inside gateAndCommit (an exchange with caller.kind turn shows it as it rides there): the request opens at door business, made_by shop, for Alex M., a customer on Lee's Barbershop's own list (K-28 customer-alex-barbershop), so the K-04 head's booker is Alex. The values the words name are decide's part fields, each re-parsed from Sam's words with his text's send time under limit 6 before any write, and stored here so the read-back and the reply read them as facts with versions (README default 43): 'haircut' is the barbershop's svc-lees-haircut with the shop's way (flow A), copied into the K-30 line at the $35 rule in force; 'Sat 11am Riley' is Sat Oct 24 11:00 to 11:30am New York time with res-riley (the 30 minutes are the haircut's length as an example), held for the booking by K-05 reserve right after the commit, 10 minutes. Alex is on the list, so no contact is sent: the reply takes his from his row (README default 49). Sam's text's own safety read rides in the same commit (README default 5), so safetyOutcomeId is null. The read-back goes to Sam next (A3-29, A3-30).
